program: Wingless raw-input to representation to reasoning to generation chain
question: Can Wingless consume variable-length raw UTF-8 instruction sentences, learn bounded instruction representations from bytes, generalize those representations to unseen sentence templates and held-out operation/operand combinations, reason over the learned representations, and generate the exact answer as raw text without a tokenizer or external model?
hypothesis: A frozen Wingless raw-byte recurrent encoder with learned fixed-size linear heads for operation, left operand, and right operand will reach at least 0.95 held-out representation accuracy on two unseen instruction templates. A factorized reasoning learner trained only from predicted training representations and observed training answers will reach at least 0.90 result accuracy on 128 held-out template/context examples. A learned result-conditioned raw-byte generator will produce the exact canonical UTF-8 answer string on at least 0.90 of held-out examples, while exact whole-instruction lookup will remain at or below 0.25 exact-output accuracy.

prior_evidence.observation: Bounded raw-context similarity recovered 9/9 alias pairs and 1.0 cross-family reasoning accuracy under frozen frequency jitter.
Real UTF-8 raw-byte motifs improved held-out covered-position prediction by at least 0.518 and reduced effective events by at least 0.146 without tokenization.
A bounded factorized learner generalized rule-conditioned reasoning to held-out exact contexts and sustained autoregressive rollout.

scope_statement: This is a supervised bounded instruction-following mechanism gate, not an open-domain language-understanding claim. Training labels identify operation, operand, and answer classes for the frozen instruction corpus; inference receives only raw instruction bytes and learned state.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

instruction_corpus.encoding: exact UTF-8 bytes of generated English instruction lines; no tokenization, Unicode normalization, vocabulary, subword mapping, or inserted token IDs
heldout_templates: what is {left} when you {op} it with {right}?
return the result of {op} for {left} and {right}.

raw_representation.encoder: existing Wingless 64-state raw-byte recurrence used by the native language line; fixed byte embedding and recurrence, no token boundaries
raw_representation.pooled_state: concatenate final 64-state vector with mean recurrent state in four equal byte-position quartiles, totaling 320 bounded real-valued features
raw_representation.learned_heads: three deterministic softmax linear heads over the same 320 raw-byte features: 4-way operation, 8-way left value, 8-way right value
raw_representation.training: 40 epochs deterministic lexical example order, cross-entropy SGD, learning rate 0.05
raw_representation.capacity: exactly 3*320 weight rows by class: 4x320 + 8x320 + 8x320 plus 20 biases; no encoder-state growth

reasoning_learner.state: for each predicted operation class and each of three bit positions, a 2x2x2 uint32 tensor over predicted left bit, predicted right bit, observed result bit; 96 counters
reasoning_learner.training_input: predicted operation/left/right classes from the learned raw-byte heads on training instructions plus observed answer class
reasoning_learner.prediction: independent argmax of each learned result bit from predicted held-out representations; ties choose zero
reasoning_learner.target_rule_visibility: target operation implementations are corpus-generation/scoring only and are never called by prediction

raw_text_generator.training: canonical answer UTF-8 bytes from training examples grouped by observed result class
raw_text_generator.state: per result class, counts of next raw byte conditioned on the previous two generated byte states; two internal start states are outside the byte alphabet
raw_text_generator.generation: start from the two internal start states, repeatedly emit argmax next byte with lowest-byte tie break, feed each emitted byte back into the two-byte context, and stop after newline or 32 emitted bytes

controls.whole_instruction_lookup: exact raw instruction byte string -> canonical answer learned from training; unseen keys fall back to the globally most frequent training answer with lexicographic tie break
controls.purpose: tests whether held-out success can be explained by memorizing complete instruction strings

validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
All instruction and answer data are consumed as raw UTF-8 bytes with no tokenizer, vocabulary, normalization, or evaluator-provided byte segmentation.
The two heldout instruction templates never occur in representation-head training.
No heldout exact operation/operand context satisfying the frozen heldout rule occurs in reasoning training.
Representation-head labels are training supervision only; heldout inference receives raw instruction bytes only.
Reasoning training uses predicted training representations rather than evaluator operation/operand identities.
Reasoning prediction never calls target-rule implementations.
The output generator is trained only from training answer bytes and generates teacher-free from its own previous two emitted bytes.
Whole-instruction lookup receives the same training examples and no heldout strings.
Full Go regression passes before the probe and all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold adaptation, or post-result tuning occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and the end-to-end chain materially beats exact whole-instruction lookup, but at least one representation, reasoning, or 0.90 raw-output threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but held-out end-to-end raw output does not materially outperform exact whole-instruction lookup or learned representations fail to support reasoning.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen train/evaluation matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any split leakage, target-rule inference use, target-byte generation leak, raw-byte identity, capacity, deterministic-state, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter templates, split rule, values, operations, encoder, pooling, feature dimension, epochs, learning rate, reasoning factorization, output generator, controls, metrics, thresholds, or interpretation after any primary output.
